motions.name: Biped claw slash
motions.prompt: A standing human performer acts a single fierce right-hand claw slash: crouched wind-up, a broad diagonal swipe, torso follow-through, and balanced recovery to standing. No walking. Full body stays planted in place.

motions.name: Overhead sword slash
motions.prompt: A standing human performs one two-handed overhead sword swing with an imaginary sword: both hands rise together, a strong downward cut, knees flex, and a calm balanced recovery. Feet stay in place.

motions.name: Hit recoil and recovery
motions.prompt: A standing human reacts to one impact to the upper chest: shoulders recoil, torso leans briefly backward, knees absorb the force, then the person returns to a stable ready stance. Feet remain planted.
